0022600123.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-1, 2nd in the Central and 1 game back, 5th in the East) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (0-3, 5th in the Central and 3 games back, 13th in the East) in the Pacers' fourth game of the season, with Indiana on a one-game winning streak and Milwaukee on a three-game losing streak. Indiana is 2-0 on the road and 0-1 at home, and Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring) are out for the Pacers, while Ivica Zubac is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Pacers lost all four meetings with the Bucks in 2025-26, most recently a 134-123 defeat in Milwaukee on March 15, 2026.
